The '''Imperial Garrison Complex''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] installation located on the outskirts of [[Amma]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bacrana/Legends|Bacrana]]. It was the seat of all Imperial governmental and military power in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. The complex included several fortified buildings, reinforced [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] and [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] platforms, and an [[IM-455 modular garrison]]. A [[death fence]] surrounded the Complex, and it included two anti-orbital [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]].
